name: Dynamic Island Pro

description: Ultra-fluid Apple-grade Dynamic Island for Omarchy featuring adaptive top-bar clearance detection, universal multi-machine hardware telemetry (multi-vendor NVIDIA/AMD/Intel GPU, live network bandwidth, root storage), Arch & Omarchy system updates monitor, 1-click trash cleaner, interactive AI Agent Permission Interceptor socket, real-time Cava audio visualizer, spring-morphed Peek banners, physical alert shake physics, Quick Radios/Volume/Brightness controls, and persistent Shelf.
